analytic_key_rule: OECD 4300 tax revenue as percent of total tax at t; WID p99p100 net personal wealth share at t and t+5; t 1990..2018; select all matching country/year keys without outcome-value screening.
preflight_boundary: Before registration, selected WID outcome inspection used schema and country/year keys only; no selected WID value, null flag, coefficient, or model fit was inspected. Treatment-only values were used for feasibility: 1,037 candidate keys across 38 countries and 29 tax years; 29 countries vary; four slight negative net-receipt ratios; residualized treatment concentration top 1% rows 0.223749, largest country 0.167271, largest year 0.065836. Gates were fixed before selected outcome values. Prior separate recurrent-tax/WID level design stopped at two 0-100 range flags; this new treatment and five-year change design retains signed net receipts and does not treat a net-wealth share above 100 as automatically invalid.
source_root_note: Paths are relative to the checkout supplying the exact pinned vintages; --source-root can point to the primary IESET checkout when this isolated worktree lacks ignored vintages.
